title: Fresh Off The Boat, Straight Into Paper
hero_alt: A box of beer-battered fish, calamari, prawns and chips on a picnic blanket at the beach
body: This is where Red Hot Cod started, and it's still the heart of the shop: wild-caught cod, flake, dory, snapper and Tassie salmon, battered or grilled to order and wrapped up for the beach across the road.
Walk up to the counter, phone ahead, or order online for pickup. Gluten-free batter is available on request, and everything comes in eco-friendly packaging.

highlights.title: Beer-Battered Fish
highlights.body: Cod, dory, snapper, flake or sea perch, battered fresh to order.

highlights.body: Crumbed in coconut and served with sweet chilli.
